description: This file defines the 'Task' class within the OrangeHRM framework's console scheduling module. The class extends a crontab 'Event', managing scheduled tasks, executing commands, and handling errors with logging.

classes.name: Task
classes.description: Represents a scheduled task that executes a console command within the OrangeHRM framework, with error handling and logging capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Task with ID, command info, console instance, and output. Finds the corresponding console command.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Executes the console command associated with this task, handling exceptions and returning an exit code.

methods.name: getCommand
methods.description: Returns the CommandInfo object associated with this task.
